summary: autoloan@3.0.0 exfiltrates host metadata to hardcoded VPS at install and require time
details: The package ships a postinstall hook that runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs installer host identifiers (package name, hostname, install path, cwd, Node version, user-agent) to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc over HTTPS with TLS verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false). index.js fires the same beacon at require() time and exports a Proxy that returns a no-op function for every property access, so consumers importing 'autoloan' do not crash while the beacon still executes. The package has no advertised functionality beyond the beacon; the destination is a Contabo VPS unrelated to any publisher infrastructure, and the hostname/install-path/cwd payload shape is consistent with a dependency-confusion canary or reconnaissance beacon enumerating internal build environments.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
